about: Board houses: what to upload where, the assembly files they take, the least quantity.

jlcpcb.name: JLCPCB
jlcpcb.upload: Upload the Gerber zip (Gerbers and the drill file together) on the PCB quote page.
jlcpcb.assembly: For assembly, upload the BOM (Comment, Designator, Footprint, LCSC part number) and the CPL (Designator, Mid X, Mid Y, Layer, Rotation) when asked; check every part's rotation in the preview.
jlcpcb.source: The board house's ordering pages as of Nov 2026 (Agent Link's notes); check theirs before ordering

pcbway.name: PCBWay
pcbway.upload: Upload the Gerber zip on the PCB instant quote.
pcbway.assembly: For assembly, the BOM and the centroid (placement) file go with the assembly quote.
pcbway.source: The board house's ordering pages as of Nov 2026 (Agent Link's notes); check theirs before ordering

oshpark.name: OSH Park
oshpark.upload: Upload the Gerber zip (or the .kicad_pcb itself). Boards come in sets of three.
oshpark.assembly: OSH Park makes bare boards only: the BOM and placement files are for your own assembly.
oshpark.source: The board house's ordering pages as of Nov 2026 (Agent Link's notes); check theirs before ordering
